descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S01 Hospital follow-up: Generate with SOAP progress shows one 99231-99233 code with quoted elements, labelled a suggestion

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician, fixture Hospital patient with badge Follow-up, nothing generated yet

When Type the encounter text, keep Note Format on SOAP progress, Generate Note & Finish, open Post-Round

Then The billing card shows exactly one code from 99231-99233 with its level, Problem and Risk elements quoting the note, and says it is a suggestion to verify

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the Post-Round snapshot, once runnerGaps 1 lands: mustContainAny 99231/99232/99233 and mustNotContain every other code of the U1 table; mustNotContain 'Analyzing note', 'generate billing suggestion' and 'No note generated yet', because a loading card, the error card or no card is not a result (oracleRules 2); 'Physician Verify' proves only the U6 label. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
